integrity: Analytical proof and finite consistency checks are provided; historical novelty remains subject to undiscovered equivalent operator-norm formulations; independent validation not performed.
scientific_limitations: Constants are supremal and not attained by finite nonzero families when d>=2. No dimension-free constant, no unequal pair norms, and no result on optimal coefficient rescaling. Analytical sharpness uses approximate Haar distributions; finite tests are not a proof.
scientific_scope: Finite equal-norm-paired rank-one operators on real/complex d-dimensional Euclidean Hilbert spaces; sharp unrescaled Bessel-to-unconditional norm constants for every d>=1.
title: Sharp real and complex spherical constants for balanced rank-one multiplier norms
